release_notes.headline_external: New queue surface for bulk triage into outcome buckets
highlights: Agents can create a queue triage review with {surface: queue, items: [...], options: [...]} — one minimal create call
Reviewer assigns each item to an outcome bucket (accept/reject/defer or custom) in a single worklist view
Decision is a clean {item: bucket} mapping; supports revision and pre-population like all other surfaces
Catalog now covers 5 distinct decision shapes: gallery, pairwise, form, checklist, queue
